regime_context: Two themes are eligible (Coal and Banks) but the gate_helps flag is false — on China A-shares history the absolute-trend discipline did NOT reduce drawdown, so the only validated edge is absent here. The rotation read is one-narrative dominant, very narrow (2/22 eligible), with coal slightly ahead of banks and weak absorption. Treat this as a high-variance, mean-reverting tape where the detector offers little conditional signal.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the one-narrative Coal leadership hands off to Banks — the condition that would retire this watch is Coal staying the leader while Banks' crowding_z stays above 1.5 for two consecutive week-ending observations (a confirmed no-handoff).

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal tops the momentum rank and is the rotation leader, but its hurst_tag is mean-revert, breadth is only 0.5, durability_bar is mid (0.54), and gate_helps is false for this market. Leadership here is likely fragile and non-trending; the only valid leg (trend-gate) already fails on this market's history.
evidence: gate_helps=false — trend gate did not reduce drawdown on A-shares history
theses.dissent: Coal is the confirmed leader with positive absolute r10 and is not crowded; in a sustained mean-reverting tape it could simply keep drifting with the dominant one-narrative flow.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS underperforms the CSI 300 benchmark by more than 4% over any 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the challenger with high breadth (0.944) and a trend hurst_tag, but crowding_z is elevated (1.74, crowded=true). Per the guardrails crowding is not a fade — it only downsizes. Since the candidate is crowded but direction itself is not validated on this mean-reverting tape, the honest lean is to avoid rather than express direction.
evidence: gate_helps=false — no validated trend edge in this market
theses.dissent: Banks have the strongest breadth and a trend tag — if a genuine trend regime forms, crowded-but-trending banks could outperform despite the crowding flag.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS outperforms CSI 300 by more than 3% over a 10-day window before the check-by date
